messages:
Sasha (Marketing): Heads-up — benchmark blog + performance deep-dive targeted publish Wed 09:00 PT (embargoed). Need press availability window, on-call reporters, and spokespeople list. Who's free for a quick pre-brief 08:30 PT? :eyes:
Sara (PR): 09:00 PT embargo works for media lists. I'll own outreach. Can Mike do a quick pre-brief? Also need phone standby 09:00–10:30 PT. :phone:
Mike (CEO): I can do 08:30–09:00 PT pre-brief. Prefer short Q&A.
Olga (Comms): We'll need a 1‑pager + assets (graphs, method slide, short quote options). Sasha — can marketing assemble?
Sasha (Marketing): Yes — draft assets + 1-pager on me. Will avoid any absolute claims per legal. 
Tom (Legal): Confirmed — please do not claim "lowest latency" or similar without direct head-to-head data. Send embargo text for clearance.
Devon (Eng): I'll attach the benchmark methodology and raw numbers. Will include exact hardware, batch configs, seeds, and run scripts.
Sasha (Marketing): Great. @Devon can you also export a PNG of the perf graph at 1200x600 for the blog?
Devon (Eng): Yep — PNG + CSV by EOD Tue. I'll also drop the run command snippet: ```bash
python run_bench.py --model=model-v1 --seq=1024 --reps=5
```
Sara (PR): Draft embargo line for clearance: "Under embargo until Wed 09:00 PT — Redwood Inference releases..." Tom, ok to use?
Tom (Legal): Fine to use embargo phrasing. Send the full paragraph for my sign-off.
Olga (Comms): Draft social copy incoming. Will prep two lengths: 280 and 100 chars. Also need a short CEO quote. Sasha — Mike prefers options?
Mike (CEO): Send two quote options. Keep them short and product-focused. Happy to sign off.
Alex (Sales): I can handle enterprise press calls 09:30–10:30 PT. Standby for any customer-specific inquiries.
Sara (PR): Call roster for 09:00–10:30 PT: Mike (CEO) 09:00–09:30, Devon (Eng) 09:00–10:00, Alex (Sales) 09:30–10:30. I'll create the calendar invites.
press-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish job queued for 2065432100 (automated). :robot_face:
Sasha (Marketing): Quick checklist: 1) Final blog + assets by EOD Tue, 2) Embargo text + legal sign-off, 3) Press list + invites, 4) Pre-brief 08:30 PT, 5) Phone standby 09:00–10:30 PT.
Sara (PR): Also — embargo holds: no leaks to journalists, no early screenshots. If any media reaches out early, route to me.
Olga (Comms): Internal comms: will post internal note to #announcements at publish time and a short explainer for CS/Support. Sasha — please drop an ops blurb for eng-oncall.
Sasha (Marketing): Will do. Ops blurb: expected traffic spike, routing to canary first, fallback to standard model if latency > 600ms.
Devon (Eng): Noted. I'll set a perf alert and add rollout guardrails.
Mike (CEO): Approved. Good work team.
Sara (PR): I'll send calendar invites and the press pack once assets land.
Sasha (Marketing): Thank you all — will ping when final assets uploaded. :rocket:
